from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, itertools
cases=[
'.a { b: selector-append(".x", "&"); }',
'.a { b: selector-append("&", ".x"); }',
'.a { b: selector-nest("&", ".x"); }',
'.a { b: selector-nest(".x", "&"); }',
'.a { b: selector-append(".x", ".y", "&"); }',
'.a { b: selector-nest(".x", ".y", "&"); }',
'.a { b: selector-append("&", "&"); }',
'.a { b: selector-nest("&", "&"); }',
'.a { b: selector-append(".x", "&", ".y"); }',
'.a { b: selector-nest(".x", "&", ".y"); }',
'.a { b: selector-append(".x", ".y", "&", ".z"); }',
'.a { b: selector-nest(".x", ".y", "&", ".z"); }',
]
for i,c in enumerate(cases):
    p=Path(f'/tmp/case{i}.scss'); p.write_text(c)
    r=subprocess.run(['./bin/sassc', str(p)], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    print(i, r.returncode, r.stderr.decode('utf-8','ignore').splitlines()[:1])
